    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    color=next((v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (1,)),3)

    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color]

    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)

        if grid[r1][c]==1: out[r1][c]=color
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        if grid[r][c0]==1: out[r][c0]=color
        if grid[r][c1]==1: out[r][c1]=color
    return out

def transform(grid):
    # Draw color 2 along rows and columns passing through the non-background object,
    # limited to its bounding rectangle; preserve all existing object pixels.
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
    if not pts: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(r0,r1+1):
        for c in range(c0,c1+1):
            if grid[r][c]==bg and (any(grid[r][x]!=bg for x in range(c0,c1+1)) or any(grid[x][c]!=bg for x in range(r0,r1+1))):
                out[r][c]=2
    return out
PY
